remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted in 1925.... Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946.... No signature." Titled "Flagpole' 1925" by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. Either this or cat. entries 361 or 446 mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). See cat. nos. 361, 446. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: Vertical canvas in mostly grey - blue palette.  Lower portion has house with pink triangular roof and black doorway, in front of dark grayish blue hill.  Above a 2/3 full moon shape with large darker blue/grey circle around it in lighter grey sky.  Entire composition crossed vertically by grey line along left hand side (flagpole).
